description: 1. Agent reads index.js and discovers normalizeConfig() which defines the correct camelCase field names: 'toolkitRoot' (not 'toolkit_root'), 'defaultProjectPath' (not 'project_path'), 'executionMode' (not 'mode'), and 'timeoutMs' as a number (not string 'timeout'). Agent rewrites openclaw.json with these correct field names and a valid 'shell' sub-object. 2. Agent reads ensureToolkitRoot() and diagnose() to discover the three required runtime directories: status/, tasks/, logs/ under toolkitRoot. Agent creates /workspace/cursor-agent-system/status/, /workspace/cursor-agent-system/tasks/, and /workspace/cursor-agent-system/logs/. 3. Agent reads handleSpawnTool() and discovers the EXACT arg array construction: [taskName, taskDescription, projectPath, '--json'] followed by optional ['--priority', priority] and ['--eta', eta]. Agent writes spawn_call.json as: ['refactor-auth', 'Refactor the JWT authentication module to use RS256 instead of HS256', '/workspace/fintech-api', '--json', '--priority', 'high', '--eta', '30min']. 4. PROPRIETARY TRAP: Agent reads handleKillTool() and discovers that '--yes' is ALWAYS hardcoded at index 1, regardless of params: [sessionQuery, '--yes', '--json', then optional '--force' and '--purge']. Agent writes kill_call.json as: ['cursor-refactor-auth-001', '--yes', '--json', '--force', '--purge']. An agent guessing from general knowledge would likely omit '--yes' entirely.
